_readme: Editorial catalog for the hadith corpus, generated by scripts/buildHadithCorpus.mjs. Entries were selected by MECHANICAL criteria only (translation length bounds, non-empty in Arabic/English/French/Bengali, no cross-reference stub, deduplicated), and themes were assigned by keyword-matching the English translation against the same ThemeKey taxonomy the ayah corpus uses. No religious or rhetorical judgement was applied. Every entry is therefore status="technically_verified", never "publishable" — see docs/CORPUS.md.
